What should I do if the tracking never updates?
16:40
Willow

Sorry about the worry—tracking can occasionally lag. Here’s what to try:

• Check the courier link in your dispatch email/SMS and refresh later in the day. Some Royal Mail services show limited scans and only update on delivery.
• Give it a little time: scans often appear the evening before or morning of delivery. Weekends and bank holidays can delay updates.
• If it’s DPD, you should see scans once they’ve received the parcel; if there’s still no update by the evening before the delivery date, it may move to the next working day.
• Double‑check your spam/junk folder for any courier updates.
• Look around safe places/with neighbours in case it was delivered without a scan.

If the selected delivery date has passed and there’s still no movement by the next day, please get in touch and we’ll investigate with the courier and put things right.

If you’d like me to check a specific order now, share your order number and postcode, and I’ll take a look.

Short answer: rerouting to a different address isn’t something we can do once an order is placed, and especially not after it’s shipped. This is for security and to keep gifts safe.

What we can do instead:
• If it hasn’t shipped yet: we can try to cancel so you can place a new order to the correct address.
• If it has shipped: use the courier’s in‑flight options via the tracking link.
– DPD: usually allows deliver to a Pickup Shop, a neighbour, leave in a safe place, or change the delivery day (not a new address).
– Royal Mail: limited in‑flight changes; you may be able to arrange redelivery or collect from a local delivery office if they’ve attempted delivery.
